paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: The figure illustrates the distribution of errors encountered when using GPT-4, categorized into various types. The chart is a pie chart, divided into seven sections, each representing a different error category. The sections are labeled as "Incorrect" (blue, 43.6%), "Correct" (red, 31.6%), "Partial" (yellow, 11.3%), "Unknown" (orange, 8.3%), "Syntax Error" (green, 2.3%), "Bad Response" (teal, 1.5%), and an unlabeled section is not present. The percentages are displayed next to or within their corresponding sections. The chart provides a visual representation of the proportion of each error type, with "Incorrect" being the largest category. Annotations and labels are placed adjacent to or within their respective sections, and the chart title "Distribution of Errors with GPT-4" is displayed at the top.
